about: Order: (1) every district of Punjab; (2) the district holding each state or union territory capital; (3) every other district, state by state in OMMAS order. State and district names are OMMAS's own, read on 17 November 2026. Each unit reads the default month window (the current month and the 11 before it). Districts already run earlier are not run again. Award phase: every district (or the district of a municipal corporation or urban body) given a Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari (JSJB 1.0) award on 18 Nov 2025, from the PIB release of 11 Nov 2025 (https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2188706) and the Department of Water Resources awardee list (https://www.jalshakti-dowr.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/11/33c8968f7421c53f2e85fc72b3ed95de.pdf). Ordered by award size: Category 1, municipal corporations and the urban body, then Category 2, then Category 3. Names are matched to this portal's own spelling.
